infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: STYLO needs access to your camera to take photos of your outfits for style evaluation and wardrobe organization.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: STYLO needs access to your photo library to select outfit photos for style evaluation and to save your favorite looks.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: STYLO needs permission to save outfit photos and style evaluations to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: STYLO may need microphone access for video recording of outfit evaluations.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: STYLO sends notifications about style tips, outfit reminders, and new features to enhance your fashion experience.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: STYLO connects to your local development server to enable live updates while building the app.

plugins.photosPermission: STYLO needs access to your photo library to select outfit photos for style evaluation.
plugins.cameraPermission: STYLO needs access to your camera to take photos of your outfits for style evaluation.
